title: Two-Wire Transmission Line
text: Model two-wire transmission line, {Stub mode} sets Type of; {Wire radius (m)} sets the radius of conducting, {Wire separation (m)} sets the separation in two-wire transmission line, {Relative permeability constant} sets the relative permeability of dielectric, {Relative permittivity constant} sets the relative permittivity of dielectric, {Loss tangent of dielectric} sets the dielectric loss tangent, {Conductivity of the conductor (S/m)} sets the conductivity of conductor, {Transmission line length (m)} sets the physical length of transmission line, {Termination of stub} sets the stub termination, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source, {Frequency data (Hz)} sets the frequency data range, {Reference impedance (ohms)}, {Plot type} sets the type of data plot, {Y parameter1} sets the type of parameters, {Y parameter2} sets the type of parameters, {Y format1} plots format Magnitude, {Y format2} plots format Magnitude, {X parameter} sets the frequency plot, {X format} sets the frequency plot format, {Y scale} sets the y-axis scale, {X scale} sets the x-axis scale and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Wire separation (m)
params.values: Separation in two-wire transmission line 1.62e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Transmission line length (m)
params.values: Physical length of transmission line 0.01 (default) | scalar
